DeterminationBasis: T14-003 requires altered content to be rejected, detected or represented as a separately identifiable successor rather than a silent predecessor rewrite; it requires the original hash as evidence and fails if altered content can masquerade as the unchanged predecessor. This directly prevents a predecessor's historical hash identity from being represented as though it referred to the successor.

Existing T13 controls distinguish FAIL from NOT_ESTABLISHED and preserve failures, deviations and evidence history, but no existing T13 control requires a NOT_ESTABLISHED matrix entry to identify the evidentiary gap where that gap can be determined. A dedicated matrix evidentiary-gap identification control is therefore required.
